project.name: Zahhak
project.brief: Zahhak, a prince who let the evil spirit Ahriman kiss his shoulders, grows two black serpents from them that must be fed human brains. He seizes the throne of Iran and rules for a thousand years. Fereydun, a young prince of the old royal line raised in hiding, rises with the blacksmith Kaveh's leather-apron banner, strikes Zahhak down with an ox-headed mace and chains him in a cave of Mount Damavand.
project.look: Ancient Iran as the Shahnameh imagines it, drawn from late Parthian and Sasanian art. Kings wear long silk robes with wide sleeves and embroidered roundels of beasts, wide belts with gold plaques, pearl and gold jewellery, and tall crowns with crenellations or wings. Warriors wear knee-length lamellar armour of small steel plates laced with coloured cord over long kaftans, conical segmented helmets with mail curtains, loose trousers gathered at the ankle and soft heelless boots. Palaces are of stone and mud brick with tall arched iwans, carved stucco and patterned carpets; mountains are bare and rocky. Colours are earth tones, deep red, saffron, lapis blue and gold.

characters.name: Zahhak
characters.description: Zahhak, the serpent-shouldered tyrant king of Iran, proud, cold and cruel, in the prime of a long unnatural life
characters.appearance: a long hard face, a full black beard trimmed square at the chest, heavy dark eyebrows, cold narrow dark eyes, a thin mouth, pale olive skin
characters.build: tall and broad-shouldered, heavy-set, upright royal bearing
characters.outfit: a long royal robe of deep crimson silk embroidered with golden roundels of lions, a wide golden belt, a short dark-blue over-robe open at the front, soft red leather boots

states.name: Chained
states.description: bound with heavy iron chains around his chest and wrists, his robe torn, the serpents writhing

belongings.name: Zahhak's crown
belongings.description: the tall golden crown of the kings of Iran, worn by the usurper
belongings.size: a tall crown, as high as a hand
belongings.materials: gold set with rubies and pearls
belongings.details: a crenellated golden band with a crescent and a ball on top, strings of pearls hanging at the sides

marks.what: two large black serpents growing out of his shoulders, one from each, their heads rising beside his own head
marks.size: each as thick as a forearm

garments.name: crimson robe
garments.details: a long royal robe of deep crimson silk embroidered with golden roundels of lions

garments.name: golden belt
garments.details: a wide golden belt with gold plaques

garments.name: blue over-robe
garments.details: a short dark-blue over-robe open at the front

characters.name: Fereydun
characters.description: Fereydun, a young prince of the old royal line of Iran, raised in hiding, calm, resolute and righteous, about to overthrow the tyrant
characters.appearance: a young oval face, a short dark beard just beginning, large dark eyes, a straight nose, dark wavy hair to the shoulders, warm olive skin
characters.outfit: a knee-length lamellar coat of small polished steel plates laced with blue cord, over a long saffron kaftan woven with roundels of birds, a conical segmented steel helmet with a mail curtain over the neck, a wide leather belt with bronze plaques, loose dark trousers gathered at the ankle, soft brown leather boots

garments.details: a knee-length lamellar coat of small polished steel plates laced with blue cord

garments.name: saffron kaftan
garments.details: a long saffron kaftan woven with roundels of birds, showing below the armour and at the sleeves

garments.name: conical helmet
garments.details: a conical segmented steel helmet with a mail curtain over the neck

garments.name: leather belt
garments.details: a wide leather belt with bronze plaques

garments.name: dark trousers
garments.details: loose dark trousers gathered at the ankle

garments.name: brown boots
garments.details: soft brown leather boots without heels

states.name: Royal robe
states.description: a long white silk robe embroidered with gold, a golden belt, no armour, bareheaded

belongings.name: Ox-headed mace
belongings.description: gorz-e gavsar, the heavy war mace Fereydun designed and the blacksmiths forged, its head cast in the shape of an ox's head
belongings.use_pose: raising the mace high overhead with both hands, ready to strike
belongings.size: about one metre long; the head is as big as a man's head
belongings.materials: a cast iron head, a wooden haft bound with leather, bronze fittings
belongings.colours: dark iron, worn brown leather, bronze
belongings.details: the head is shaped like an ox's head with two short curved horns, wide nostrils and a broad brow

places.name: Zahhak's throne hall
places.description: the vast throne hall of Zahhak's palace, rich and oppressive
places.anchors: a tall pointed iwan arch at the far end, a raised golden throne under it, rows of thick stone columns on both sides, a long red carpet down the middle
places.materials: carved stone and stucco, gilded details, patterned carpets
places.viewpoints: from the entrance looking toward the throne
places.recurring_objects: bronze oil lamps on tall stands along the columns

states.name: Night, lamps lit
states.description: at night, lit only by the oil lamps, warm pools of light and deep shadows

states.name: Night, lamps out
states.description: at night with every lamp out, only cold moonlight through the arch

places.name: Kaveh's forge
places.description: the blacksmith Kaveh's forge in the city, smoky and hot
places.anchors: a stone hearth with a glowing charcoal fire, a heavy iron anvil in front of it, leather bellows on the left, tools hanging on the back wall
places.materials: soot-blackened mud brick, iron, leather, wood
places.viewpoints: from the doorway looking at the anvil and the hearth
places.recurring_objects: hammers and tongs on the wall, a water trough

states.name: Fire roaring
states.description: the forge fire roaring, bright orange light and sparks filling the room

places.name: Cave of Damavand
places.description: a deep cave high on Mount Damavand where Zahhak is chained forever
places.anchors: a rough rock chamber, a narrow opening to the sky on the right, heavy iron rings driven into the back wall
places.viewpoints: from inside the cave looking at the back wall
places.recurring_objects: iron rings and chains on the wall

states.name: Storm
states.description: a storm outside, lightning flashing through the opening, rain blowing in

objects.name: Kaveh's banner
objects.description: Derafsh-e Kaviani, the blacksmith Kaveh's leather apron raised on a spear as the banner of the revolt
objects.size: a leather apron about one metre long on a spear twice a man's height
objects.materials: worn brown leather, a wooden spear shaft, an iron spearhead
objects.details: a blacksmith's leather apron with burn marks, tied by its strings to the top of a spear below the spearhead

scenes.name: The fall of Zahhak
scenes.description: In the throne hall, Fereydun brings the ox-headed mace down on Zahhak, who staggers back from his throne, the serpents rearing

scenes.name: Chained in Damavand
scenes.description: Zahhak hangs chained to the back wall of the cave of Damavand, the serpents writhing
